events.verdict: Durant (GSW) and Shumpert (SAC) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Durant (GSW) is already in Fox's (SAC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Fox (SAC) makes incidental contact that does not affect Cook's (GSW) ability to pass.
Hield (SAC) extends his arm into Thompson's (GSW) body at the end of the drive.
Looney (GSW) is already in Fox's (SAC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Iguodala (GSW) is already in Hield's (SAC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.

RAR and LLS show Shumpert (SAC) makes initial contact with the ball and with the part of Durant's (GSW) hand that is on the ball. After the initial contact he then slides down and makes contact with Durant's wrist.
Durant (GSW) absorbs the contact from Cauley-Stein (SAC) and cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Bagley III (SAC) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two legal steps after his gather.
Cook (GSW) makes contact with Bagley III's (SAC) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in enhanced video] PXP shows Bagley III (SAC) takes longer than 10 seconds to shoot his free throw.

Thompson (GSW) is already in Shumpert's (SAC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact. Additionally, Thompson briefly places his hand on Shumpert's side before immediately correcting.
[Observable in enhanced video] Durant (GSW) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Shumpert (SAC) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Durant (GSW) in the post.
RLB shows Cauley-Stein (SAC) does not clamp Looney's (GSW) arm during rebounding.
LAR shows Durant (GSW) turns his lower body into Hield (SAC). Any contact is marginal and does not affect Hield's ability to defend.
Cook (GSW) makes contact with Fox's (SAC) body during his shooting motion on his jump shot.
Shumpert (SAC) engages with Durant (GSW) but does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Shumpert (SAC) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Durant's (GSW) drive.
Shumpert (SAC) legally contests Durant's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Iguodala (GSW) splits his feet at the start of the dribble.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes incidental contact with Looney (GSW) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the long rebound.
Bagley III (SAC) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Iguodala (GSW).
MOB shows Thompson (GSW) is bracing himself for the contact from Cauley-Stein (SAC) as he protects with but does not extend his left arm.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) maintains verticality on Thompson's (GSW) shot.
LAR shows Thompson (GSW) legally contests Hield's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
RLS shows Durant (GSW) makes contact with Bagley III (SAC) that does not affect his shot near the rim.
